purpose: Protected tests-only private giveaway creation preview; the implementation owner ships the combined green PR.
registration: Cargo automatically discovers the new integration target; --features db is required. No shared source file is frozen or changed.

commands.focused: python3 scripts/cargo_cache.py run -- test -p two-bot-discord --features db --test giveaway_preview_acceptance -- --nocapture --test-threads=1
commands.offlineControls: python3 scripts/cargo_cache.py run -- test -p two-bot-discord --features db --test giveaway_preview_acceptance control -- --nocapture --test-threads=1
commands.existingDrawRecoveryControls: python3 scripts/cargo_cache.py run -- test -p two-bot-discord --features db --test giveaway_timed_draw_acceptance -- --nocapture --test-threads=1
commands.existingDomainStoreControls: python3 scripts/cargo_cache.py run -- test -p two-bot-core --features db --test giveaway_domain_store_acceptance -- --nocapture --test-threads=1

database.missingEnvironment: Three database cases print SKIP and return; that is not execution evidence. Thirteen cases require no database.
database.scope: Only an authorized disposable test database. Never production/staging. Loopback SQL tripwires accept no protocol or credentials.
database.ci: The existing workspace integration lane discovers this non-ignored target and supplies the guarded test database. Nextest lib/bin execution alone does not run this target.

deterministicSources.requiredInherentMethod: with_create_sources(self, clock: Arc<dyn Fn() -> time::OffsetDateTime + Send + Sync>, nonce: Arc<dyn Fn() -> String + Send + Sync>) -> Self
deterministicSources.baseline: A test-local extension trait returns the existing runtime, so missing behavior fails assertions rather than compilation. An explicit baseline-adapter control keeps the trait live after the inherent method exists.
deterministicSources.nonceWitness: The injected counter must stay zero for valid/invalid previews and must supply the nonce actually stored by real create. Default production sources remain secure randomness and wall clock.

contract.surface: Optional boolean preview on existing giveaway create; no new command. Registry help and generated command reference expose it.
contract.preview: One ephemeral response, label Preview — not created, proposed invocation-channel message, absolute localized deadline, requirements, explicit create without preview next action, no components or draw secrets.
contract.presentation: Shared validated pure presentation produces matching Giveaway:, entrant/winner, Ends and Requirements: lines for preview and create. Preview-only disclosures and stored identity are excluded from parity comparison.
contract.safety: Independent bound-socket SQL tripwire plus closed-pool test; REST allowlist; injected nonce counter; primed real-pool acquisition observer; durable row/audit counts; deterministic concurrent preview completion; same-id later real create.
contract.validation: Prize scalar-count/trim boundaries, duration and multiplication overflow, winner bounds, role type, account/server-age bounds, missing required fields, optional defaults, legacy duration alias, malformed/duplicate/unknown options and existing authority/guild/activation fences.
contract.disclosures: Preview does not reserve capacity, establish eligibility or guarantee a subsequent create. Existing foreign-guild/DM routing remains silent.
contract.compatibility: Missing or false preview creates normally; replay publishes/audits once. Existing create, timed-draw, replay and recovery suites remain unchanged.

handoff.nextAction: Run the focused and unchanged-control commands with the authorized test fixture; publish actual behavior-specific RED on an exact pushed SHA before completing the test-author handoff.
handoff.implementation: Incorporate the exact acceptance commit in an isolated implementation branch. Do not edit the protected file. Return test corrections to the test author. Bundle runtime, shared pure presentation, command registration/help and generated reference in the implementation PR.
